title: One of the most significant developments in enterprise AI is the integration of autonomous AI agents into everyday busin
title_en:
One of the most significant developments in enterprise AI is the integration of autonomous AI agents into everyday business applications.

Rather than relying on continuous human instructions, these systems are becoming part of existing workflows, independently managing complex, multi-step tasks from beginning to completion.

Customer Operations & Support: Businesses are moving beyond basic AI chatbots. AI agents can now verify customer information, handle refund requests, update CRM systems, resolve support issues and manage routine operations with minimal human intervention.
title_zh:
企业人工智能最重要的发展之一是将自主人工智能代理集成到日常业务应用程序中。

这些系统不再依赖连续的人工指令，而是成为现有工作流程的一部分，独立管理从开始到完成的复杂、多步骤的任务。

客户运营和支持：企业正在超越基本的人工智能聊天机器人。

title: What if you could turn a trading idea into a fully tested strategy without spending hours writing code, analyzing charts
title_en:
What if you could turn a trading idea into a fully tested strategy without spending hours writing code, analyzing charts, or manually tweaking parameters?

That's the problem @quantpilotapp is working to solve.

@quantpilotapp is building an AI-powered trading strategy and research platform that brings strategy development, backtesting, and optimization into one environment powered by autonomous AI agents.

Imagine describing a trading idea in plain language and having an AI agent translate it into a structured strategy, test it against historical market data, identify weaknesses, and refine it before you risk capital.

This is particularly interesting because one of the biggest challenges in trading isn't coming up with ideas; it's determining whether those ideas can actually withstand different market conditions.

@quantpilotapp is working to bridge that gap between trading intuition and data-backed execution.

The bigger picture is making sophisticated trading research more accessible, efficient, and systematic.

AI in trading should be more than just automating decisions. It should help traders make better-informed ones.

That's the direction @quantpilotapp is exploring.

full_text_zh:
如果您可以将交易想法转变为经过全面测试的策略，而无需花费数小时编写代码、分析图表或手动调整参数，该怎么办？

这就是@quantpilotapp 正在努力解决的问题。

@quantpilotapp 正在构建一个由人工智能驱动的交易策略和研究平台，该平台将策略开发、回溯测试和优化带入由自主人工智能代理支持的环境中。

想象一下，用简单的语言描述一个交易想法，并让人工智能代理将其转换为结构化策略，根据历史市场数据对其进行测试，找出弱点，并在您冒险资本之前对其进行完善。

这一点特别有趣，因为交易中最大的挑战之一不是提出想法，而是提出想法。它决定了这些想法是否能够真正承受不同的市场条件。

@quantpilotapp 正在努力弥合交易直觉和数据支持执行之间的差距。

更大的前景是让复杂的交易研究变得更容易、更高效、更系统。

交易中的人工智能应该不仅仅是自动化决策。它应该可以帮助交易者做出更明智的交易。

这就是@quantpilotapp 正在探索的方向。

title_en:
𝐘𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝐀𝐈 𝐀𝐆𝐄𝐍𝐓 𝐂𝐀𝐍 𝐃𝐎 𝐌𝐎𝐑𝐄 𝐓𝐇𝐀𝐍 𝐀𝐍𝐒𝐖𝐄𝐑 𝐐𝐔𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐒.

Explored @try_caddy , and I  honestly think it's an interesting step towards making personal AI agents more useful.

Caddy is an AI assistant designed to help you manage everyday tasks through messaging. It connects with tools like Gmail, Google Calendar, Notion, Slack and Google Drive, bringing different workflows into one place.

Here's what I loved the most about Caddy:

➤ AI-powered task execution: It can help draft emails, schedule events and handle tasks instead of simply suggesting what you should do.

➤ Proactive assistance: Daily summaries, reminders and follow-ups help you stay on top of things without constantly checking different apps.

➤ Connected workflows: Its integrations make it easier to manage information across multiple platforms without switching between them.

HERE'S MY TAKE:

Caddy's biggest selling point is its approach to Agentic AI. It's moving beyond conversational AI towards agents that can understand context and take action.

However, it's still in public beta. Reliability, privacy permissions and long-term pricing are things I'd want to evaluate further before depending on it for important tasks.

It's also worth remembering that good AI products need more than visibility through SEO and GEO. They need to deliver real value once people start using them.

I'll recommend @try_caddy for founders, freelancers, content creators, project managers and anyone managing multiple digital workflows who wants an AI assistant that does more than generate responses.

探索了@try_caddy，老实说，我认为这是使个人人工智能代理更有用的有趣的一步。

Caddy 是一款人工智能助手，旨在帮助您通过消息传递管理日常任务。它与 Gmail、Google Calendar、Notion、Slack 和 Google Drive 等工具连接，将不同的工作流程整合到一处。

这是我最喜欢 Caddy 的一点：

➤ AI 支持的任务执行：它可以帮助起草电子邮件、安排事件和处理任务，而不是简单地建议您应该做什么。

➤ 主动帮助：每日摘要、提醒和跟进可帮助您掌握最新情况，而无需不断检查不同的应用程序。

➤ 连接的工作流程：其集成使跨多个平台管理信息变得更加容易，而无需在它们之间进行切换。

这是我的看法：

Caddy 的最大卖点是它的 Agentic AI 方法。它正在超越对话式人工智能，转向能够理解上下文并采取行动的代理。

然而，它仍处于公开测试阶段。在依赖它执行重要任务之前，我想进一步评估可靠性、隐私权限和长期定价。

还值得记住的是，好的人工智能产品需要的不仅仅是通过 SEO 和 GEO 获得可见性。一旦人们开始使用它们，它们就需要提供真正的价值。

title_en:
good morning creators

the final chapter is here 

@termix_ai has entered its final epoch (Epoch 4) on @KaitoAI 

this is the last opportunity to contribute, share genuine thoughts, and show support for the vision

campaign running from Nov 23 to Dec 22, 
the final epoch brings a reward pool of 32 bps, plus a separate 8 bps allocation for kaito stakers 

let's talk about what idea behind works https://t.co/NB92wv1xDD by @termix_ai 

imagine hiring an AI agent the same way you hire a person for a specific task

you explain what you need, agents compete for the job, the right one get selected and payment happens after the work is done

it's a combination of agent discovery, real work, verification, and onchain payments

It's not just about making AI smarter, it's about giving AI a place to work and create value

Giving it unlimited control is another.

That's where @FensoryApp ta
title_en:
Giving an AI agent access to trading is one thing.

Giving it unlimited control is another.

That's where @FensoryApp takes an interesting approach.

Instead of relying only on instructions written in a prompt, Fensory lets users define trading permissions at the account level.

You can decide:

→ Which markets the agent is allowed to access
→ The maximum size of a single order
→ How long trading access remains active
→ When to disable agentic trading with a kill switch

Why does this matter?

Because an AI agent can misunderstand instructions, but account-level limits create boundaries that the prompt itself cannot override.

I think this is an important part of making agent-driven trading more controlled and transparent.

Of course, these controls don't eliminate market risk. Trading can still result in losses.

Explore the infrastructure: https://t.co/PDOQfFRYQa

Fensory 不只依赖于提示中编写的指令，而是让用户在账户级别定义交易权限。

您可以决定：

→ 代理商可以进入哪些市场
→ 单笔订单最大尺寸
→ 交易访问保持活跃状态多长时间
→ 何时使用终止开关禁用代理交易

为什么这很重要？

因为 AI 代理可能会误解指令，但帐户级别限制会创建提示本身无法覆盖的边界。

我认为这是使代理驱动的交易更加可控和透明的重要组成部分。

当然，这些控制并不能消除市场风险。交易仍然可能导致损失。

summary_en: Hugging Face released a 300MB RL-trained LoRA adapter optimized for the Qwen-27B model on OpenCode tasks. Test data shows significant improvement in code generation and debugging accuracy on the SWE-bench Pro benchmark (51 hard tasks).

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Hugging Face推出了基于强化学习（RL）训练的300MB LoRA轻量化适配器，专门针对Qwen-27B模型在OpenCode编程任务中的表现进行优化。测试数据显示，在SWE-bench Pro（51项硬任务）基准测试中，该适配器显著提升了模型代码生成与修复的成功率。

ai_analysis.insight_en: Lightweight domain-specific adaptation via LoRA is becoming the primary technical pathway for mid-sized models to outperform massive baselines on niche tasks. title: BREAKING: Apple is developing an AI agent that can browse the web, use apps, and write code
title_en: BREAKING: Apple is developing an AI agent that can browse the web, use apps, and write code
title_zh: 苹果开发自主AI智能体，进军Agent市场
author: @Kalshi
author_role: AI 先锋观察者
summary_en: Apple Inc. is accelerating the development of an autonomous AI agent capable of automating web browsing, app interaction, coding, and device navigation. According to recent job postings, the system is positioned as a 'proactive agentic AI assistant' designed to simulate human operational logic, with an estimated launch as early as the end of 2026 to compete with advancements from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.
summary_zh: 苹果正开发具备自主浏览、编码与设备控制能力的AI智能体，目标直指Agent市场，预计明年底推出。
full_text_zh: 突发新闻：苹果正在开发一款人工智能代理，可以浏览网页、使用应用程序和编写代码
full_text_en: BREAKING: Apple is developing an AI agent that can browse the web, use apps, and write code

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 苹果公司正加速开发具备自主能力的AI智能体，旨在实现对网络浏览、应用程序操控、代码编写及设备导航的全面自动化执行。根据内部招聘信息，该系统定位为 proactive agentic AI assistant，旨在模拟人类操作逻辑，预计最早于2026年底推出，以应对OpenAI、Anthropic及Meta在智能体领域的先发竞争。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Apple Inc. is accelerating the development of an autonomous AI agent capable of automating web browsing, app interaction, coding, and device navigation. According to recent job postings, the system is positioned as a 'proactive agentic AI assistant' designed to simulate human operational logic, with an estimated launch as early as the end of 2026 to compete with advancements from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.

elements_zh.where: 企业内部AI战略规划
elements_zh.what: 开发具备自主执行任务能力的AI智能体，并招募高级工程经理推进项目
elements_zh.why: 旨在弥补苹果在AI智能体生态中的缺失，与Meta、OpenAI、Anthropic竞争

elements_en.what: Developing autonomous AI agents and hiring senior engineering management to lead execution
elements_en.why: To bridge gaps in the AI agent ecosystem and compete with Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 苹果的介入标志着AI智能体赛道从单纯的模型能力竞争转向OS级的系统整合竞争。通过将智能体深度嵌入底层架构，苹果意图构建极高的平台壁垒，此举将迫使竞品加速从云端应用向终端侧的深度融合，并可能重塑现有的AI应用分发格局。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Apple's entry signifies a pivot in the AI agent race from pure model capability to OS-level system integration. By embedding agents deep into its underlying architecture, Apple aims to establish a high platform barrier, forcing competitors to accelerate integration from cloud-based applications to the edge, potentially reshaping the current AI application distribution landscape.

title: 😳 Ant Ling open-sourced 2x medical AI models in 1x day. 😷 One is a 124B model that can see 👀 and interpret medical images. The other is a massive 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameters. ... and Ant claims the 560B model beats GPT-6
title_en: 😳 Ant Ling open-sourced 2x medical AI models in 1x day. 😷 One is a 124B model that can see 👀 and interpret medical images. The other is a massive 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameters. ... and Ant claims the 560B model beats GPT-6
title_zh: 蚂蚁集团开源两款医疗AI模型
author: @TeksEdge
author_role: AI 先锋观察者
summary_en: Ant Ling has open-sourced two medical AI models: a 124B vision model for medical image interpretation and a 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameters. The organization claims that the 560B model outperforms GPT-6 in clinical reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 蚂蚁集团开源124B视觉医疗模型及560B医疗推理模型，后者声称在性能上超越GPT-6。
full_text_zh: 😳 Ant Ling 在 1x 天内开源了 2x 个医疗 AI 模型。 😷 一种是 124B 模型，可以看到 👀 并解释医学图像。另一个是具有25B个主动参数的海量560B医学推理模型。 ...Ant 声称 560B 模型击败了 GPT-6

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 医疗AI正从通用多模态向专业领域深耕，蚂蚁集团通过超大规模参数与稀疏激活（25B活跃）架构，旨在解决复杂临床逻辑处理中的长尾效应。此举将医疗大模型从“闭源黑盒”推向开源，将迫使商业化医疗AI厂商重新评估其高昂的预训练成本与闭源壁垒。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Medical AI is shifting from general-purpose multimodality to domain-specific expertise, leveraging massive parameter counts with sparse activation to handle clinical logic complexity. By open-sourcing these frontier models, Ant Ling challenges the proprietary moat of commercial medical AI providers and forces a reassessment of cost-to-performance ratios in healthcare AI.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 蚂蚁集团发布并开源两款医疗专用AI模型：一款为具备医疗影像分析能力的124B参数模型，另一款为拥有560B参数规模、具备25B活跃参数的医疗推理模型。该机构宣称其560B模型在临床推理表现上已超越GPT-6基准。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Ant Ling has open-sourced two medical AI models: a 124B vision model for medical image interpretation and a 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameters. The organization claims that the 560B model outperforms GPT-6 in clinical reasoning benchmarks.

key_points_en: Ant Ling open-sourced 124B and 560B medical AI models
560B model uses sparse activation (25B active params) and claims to outperform GPT-6
Fills the gap in open-source clinical reasoning models and integrates medical vision with logic

title:
AI agent trust should look like a staircase, not a switch.

1. Grant one narrow capability
2. Test it on a defined task
title_en:
AI agent trust should look like a staircase, not a switch.

1. Grant one narrow capability
2. Test it on a defined task
3. Verify the result
4. Unlock the next capability
5. Keep every level revocable

Autonomy is earned in stages, not assumed at launch. https://t.co/M0DS7wztiI

人工智能代理信任应该看起来像一个楼梯，而不是一个开关。

5. 保持每个级别都是可撤销的

自主权是分阶段获得的，而不是在发布时就假定的。 http

I was merely involved in arguing for opening Llama-2.
title_en:
@krutosh @huxlab I wasn't involved in the technical side of Llama.
I was merely involved in arguing for opening Llama-2.
The opening of Llama-2 jump-started the AI industry.
Llama-3 was good.
Llama-4 was a disappointment because the team was under huge time pressure and had to be conservative.
Then Mark rebooted the whole AI organization and the open model policy was temporarily put on hold.
After that (but not entirely because of that), I left to start AMI Labs.
title_zh:
@krutosh @huxlab 我没有参与 Llama 的技术方面。
我只是参与了开放 Llama-2 的争论。
Llama-2 的开通带动了人工智能产业的发展。
Llama-3 很好。
Llama-4 令人失望，因为团队面临着巨大的时间

@krutosh @huxlab I wasn't involved in the technical side of Llama.
I was merely involved in arguing for opening Llama-2.
The opening of Llama-2 jump-started the AI industry.
Llama-3 was good.
Llama-4 was a disappointment because the team was under huge time pressure and had to be conservative.

full_text_zh:
@krutosh @huxlab 我没有参与 Llama 的技术方面。
我只是参与了开放 Llama-2 的争论。
Llama-2 的开通带动了人工智能产业的发展。
Llama-3 很好。
Llama-4 令人失望，因为团队面临着巨大的时间压力，不得不采取保守的态度。
随后马克重新启动了整个人工智能组织，开放模型政策暂时搁置。
之后（但不完全是因为这个），我离开并创办了 AMI 实验室。

title:
T3 Code founder just shared his personal setup for building agentic teams with Grok Bot + Opus 5.5

one Grok Bot runs yo
title_en:
T3 Code founder just shared his personal setup for building agentic teams with Grok Bot + Opus 5.5

one Grok Bot runs your whole fleet of machines. Opus 5.5 does the coding. you only approve

how:

→ Grok Bot gets one MCP link to T3 Code
→ you give it one rule: code goes to Opus 5.5
→ it spins up threads on every machine you own
→ works from your phone, even with the laptop closed

save the video, here's the guide:

• step 0 → what it is:

Grok Bot = always-on agent with its own cloud computer

T3 Code = open-source control plane for coding agents. free, runs on your machines, uses your subscriptions

• step 1 → the stack:

- Claude $100 plan → Opus 5.5 for the actual code
- Grok Bot → the dispatcher that never sleeps
- T3 Code on every box you want it to control

• step 2 → connect the fleet:

run npx t3 connect on each machine. one command, free, no Tailscale needed

• step 3 → give Grok Bot the keys:

Settings → Environments → Copy MCP URL → paste it into Grok Bot, sign in with OAuth. it can now see every linked machine

• step 4 → the one rule Theo uses:

tell Grok Bot "call T3 Code with Opus 5.5 for any task where it is applicable"

code runs on your Claude plan, Grok Bot's limits stay free for planning

• step 5 → make it work:

- "spin up an Opus 5.5 thread on each machine to check disk & RAM"
- "go through these PRs and pick the best ones"
- "split the backlog, one thread per issue, each in its own worktree"

every thread gets its own branch. nothing merges without your approval

what to expect:
- 8 threads on 8 machines from one chat (Theo's demo)
- works over the internet, not computer use
- control everything from your phone
- T3 Code: $0. you pay for Claude + Grok Bot only

honest take:

this is a dispatcher, not magic. bad briefs still give bad PRs, and you still review every diff. the win: your agents keep working while you're away from the desk

Save it so you don't lose it. 

then read the full guide on building AI agent teams in T3 Code in the article below ↓

full_text_zh:
T3 Code 创始人刚刚分享了他使用 Grok Bot + Opus 5.5 构建代理团队的个人设置

一个 Grok Bot 可以运行您的整个机器群。 Opus 5.5 负责编码。你只认可

如何：

→ Grok Bot 获得一个指向 T3 代码的 MCP 链接
→ 你给它一条规则：代码转到 Opus 5.5
→ 它会在你拥有的每台机器上旋转线程
→ 即使笔记本电脑关闭，也可以通过手机工作

保存视频，这是指南：

• 步骤 0 → 它是什么：

Grok Bot = 拥有自己的云计算机的永远在线代理

T3 Code = 用于编码代理的开源控制平面。免费，在您的计算机上运行，​​使用您的订阅

• 步骤1 → 堆栈：

- Claude 100 美元计划 → Opus 5.5 的实际代码
- Grok Bot → 不眠的调度员
- 您希望它控制的每个盒子上都有 T3 代码

• 步骤2 → 连接车队：

在每台计算机上运行 npx t3 connect。一个命令，免费，无需 Tailscale

• 步骤 3 → 给 Grok Bot 密钥：

设置 → 环境 → 复制 MCP URL → 将其粘贴到 Grok Bot，使用 OAuth 登录。它现在可以看到每台链接的机器

• 步骤 4 → Theo 使用的一条规则：

告诉 Grok Bot“使用 Opus 5.5 调用 T3 代码来执行任何适用的任务”

代码在您的 Claude 计划上运行，Grok Bot 的限制对计划保持免费

• 步骤 5 → 使其发挥作用：

- “在每台机器上启动 Opus 5.5 线程来检查磁盘和 RAM”
-“浏览这些 PR 并选择最好的”
- “拆分待办事项，每个问题一个线程，每个线程都在自己的工作树中”

每个线程都有自己的分支。未经您的批准，任何内容都不会合并

期待什么：
- 8 台机器上的 8 个线程通过一次聊天（Theo 的演示）
- 通过互联网工作，而不是使用计算机
- 通过手机控制一切
- T3 代码：0 美元。您只需支付 Claude + Grok Bot 的费用

诚实地采取：

这是调度员，不是魔法。糟糕的内裤仍然会带来糟糕的公关，而你仍然会审查每一个差异。胜利：当您离开办公桌时，您的座席仍能继续工作

保存它，以免丢失。

然后阅读下面文章中关于在 T3 代码中构建 AI 代理团队的完整指南 ↓

设置 → 环境 → 复制 MCP URL → 将其粘贴到 Grok Bot，使用 OAuth 登录。它现在可以看到每台链接的机器

• 步骤 4 → Theo 使用的一条规则：

告诉 Grok Bot“使用 Opus 5.5 调用 T3 代码来执行任何适用的任务”

代码在您的 Claude 计划上运行，Grok Bot 的限制对计划保持免费

• 步骤 5 → 使其发挥作用：

- “在每台机器上启动 Opus 5.5 线程来检查磁盘和 RAM”
-“浏览这些 PR 并选择最好的”
- “拆分待办事项，每个问题一个线程，每个线程都在自己的工作树中”

每个线程都有自己的分支。未经您的批准，任何内容都不会合并

期待什么：
- 8 台机器上的 8 个线程通过一次聊天（Theo 的演示）
- 通过互联网工作，而不是使用计算机
- 通过手机控制一切
- T3 代码：0 美元。您只需支付 Claude + Grok Bot 的费用

诚实地采取：

这是调度员，不是魔法。糟糕的内裤仍然会带来糟糕的公关，而你仍然会审查每一个差异。胜利：当您离开办公桌时，您的座席仍能继续工作

保存它，以免丢失。

然后阅读下面文章中关于在 T3 代码中构建 AI 代理团队的完整指南 ↓

title: @merettm Pretraining should just be called “training”. You can’t have pre and post, but never have actual training. Like
title_en:
@merettm Pretraining should just be called “training”. You can’t have pre and post, but never have actual training. Like, you dress up to work out and then you shower, but don’t actually work out 😂

Unless I’m super missing something, data starvation will be the training challenge next year.
title_zh:
@merettm 预训练应该被称为“训练”。你不可能有事前和事后，但永远不会有实际的训练。就像，你穿好衣服去锻炼，然后洗澡，但实际上并没有锻炼😂

除非我超级错过了什么，否则数据匮乏将成为明年的训练挑战。

title: I’ve been having “Fix It Days” with Opus 5.5 where I just lay out a list of things that aren’t working and go one by one
title_en:
I’ve been having “Fix It Days” with Opus 5.5 where I just lay out a list of things that aren’t working and go one by one and fix them. 

Oh, Paramount+ is blurry? Okay. 

Check another episode, check another show, check another app, reset the app, unplug the TV. Boom. Fixed. 

Your iCloud is messed up? 
Your thermostat keeps resetting?
Your clock won’t keep time?
Your closet door won’t close right? 
Bank keeps mailing your old address?

I could have figured these all out on my own or with YouTube, but it’s far less stressful and I get through them faster.
title_zh:
我一直在使用 Opus 5.5 进行“修复日”，我只是列出了一系列不起作用的事情，然后逐一修复它们。

哦，Paramount+ 模糊了？好的。

检查另一集，检查另一个节目，检查另一个应用程序，重置应用程序，拔掉电视插头。繁荣。固定的

summary_en: Google's research team has introduced BuggyMLE, a machine learning engineering evaluation framework designed to address the saturation of current repository-level coding benchmarks. ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌研究团队发布名为BuggyMLE的机器学习工程评估框架，旨在应对当前仓库级编码基准测试趋于饱和的难题。该技术通过在测试任务中主动注入人工错误，迫使大模型在更复杂的纠错与系统级工程场景中展现性能，从而实现对模型编码能力的精细化压力测试。

elements_zh.what: 推出BuggyMLE基准框架，利用主动注入代码缺陷提升智能体工程能力
elements_zh.why: 现有仓库级基准测试趋于饱和，无法有效衡量AI处理复杂真实工程问题的能力

elements_en.what: Launched BuggyMLE benchmark, using active bug injection to improve agent engineering skills
elements_en.why: Existing repository-level benchmarks are saturating and fail to measure real-world complex engineering tasks

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 通过BuggyMLE实现从‘生成代码’向‘工程化调试’的范式转变，揭示了LLM基准测试正从静态数据集匹配向动态对抗演进。这种基于错误反馈闭环的训练逻辑，是AI智能体实现工业级软件交付能力的必经路径，能够显著提升模型在处理分布式系统缺陷时的鲁棒性。
ai_analysis.insight_en: BuggyMLE signals a paradigm shift from simple code generation to systematic debugging, illustrating that LLM benchmarking is evolving from static dataset matching to dynamic adversarial evaluation. This feedback-loop approach is essential for AI agents to achieve industrial-grade delivery capabilities and significantly improves model robustness in handling distributed system defects.

Uses proactive bug injection to enhance debugging and diagnostic capabilities in complex engineering
Shift towards closed-loop training focused on real-world engineering logic
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 通过BuggyMLE实现从‘生成代码’向‘工程化调试’的范式转变，揭示了LLM基准测试正从静态数据集匹配向动态对抗演进。这种基于错误反馈闭环的训练逻辑，是AI智能体实现工业级软件交付能力的必经路径，能够显著提升模型在处理分布式系统缺陷时的鲁棒性。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: BuggyMLE signals a paradigm shift from simple code generation to systematic debugging, illustrating that LLM benchmarking is evolving from static dataset matching to dynamic adversarial evaluation. This feedback-loop approach is essential for AI agents to achieve industrial-grade delivery capabilities and significantly improves model robustness in handling distributed system defects.

title: I helped start OpenAI because I want AGI to be safe and beneficial for people. This post provides transparency that can
title_en:
I helped start OpenAI because I want AGI to be safe and beneficial for people. This post provides transparency that can be the foundation of industry-wide shared safety bars.

Perhaps the most important concept from the post is the following: "AI will also significantly contribute to progress on alignment and monitoring, I think that progress is unlikely to be fast enough to allow the full potential acceleration in pretraining."

Towards ensuring that safety keeps pace with general intelligence of pretrained models (as measured by "perplexity"), the post proposes "common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone (such as the development of a successor to CoT monitors)."

The general idea is to create a first shared limit, on some shared key metric, along with concrete exit criteria that would allow going beyond that. This can lead to a "common framework for setting successive limits and pacing further development".

Excited to move forward the conversation on pacing towards shared standards that are rooted in the science!

我帮助创立了 OpenAI，因为我希望 AGI 对人们来说是安全且有益的。这篇文章提供了透明度，可以成为全行业共享安全栏的基础。

full_text_en:
I helped start OpenAI because I want AGI to be safe and beneficial for people. This post provides transparency that can be the foundation of industry-wide shared safety bars.

Perhaps the most important concept from the post is the following: "AI will also significantly contribute to progress on alignment and monitoring, I think that progress is unlikely to be fast enough to allow the full potential acceleration in pretraining."

Towards ensuring that safety keeps pace with general intelligence of pretrained models (as measured by "perplexity"), the post proposes "common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone (such as the development of a successor to CoT monitors)."

The general idea is to create a first shared limit, on some shared key metric, along with concrete exit criteria that would allow going beyond that. This can lead to a "common framework for setting successive limits and pacing further development".

Excited to move forward the conversation on pacing towards shared standards that are rooted in the science!
full_text_zh:
我帮助创立了 OpenAI，因为我希望 AGI 对人们来说是安全且有益的。这篇文章提供了透明度，可以成为全行业共享安全栏的基础。

也许这篇文章中最重要的概念如下：“人工智能还将极大地促进对齐和监控方面的进展，我认为进展不太可能快到足以实现预训练的全部潜在加速。”

为了确保安全性与预训练模型的通用智能（以“困惑度”衡量）保持同步，该帖子提出了“基于困惑度和其他衡量标准的共同限制，开发人员承诺在我们理解和监控人工智能行为的能力达到某个具体里程碑（例如开发 CoT 监视器的继任者）之前不会跨越这些限制。”

总体思路是在某些共享关键指标上创建第一个共享限制，以及允许超越该限制的具体退出标准。这可以形成一个“设定连续限制和进一步发展步伐的共同框架”。

很高兴能够推进关于迈向植根于科学的共同标准的对话！
